title: Neymar spotted on mobility scooter at theme park days after Brazil World Cup disaster - AOL
snippet: Brazilian soccer icon Neymar was seen getting around Universal Orlando Resort on a mobility scooter after Brazil's World Cup elimination.
extractedText: Neymar spotted on mobility scooter at theme park days after Brazil World Cup disasterKelly WilliamsSun, July 12, 2026 at 11:35 PM UTC0Video grab of Brazil legend Neymar seen driving a mobility scooter at Universal Orlando Resort after World Cup exit -Credit:Reach Publishing Services LimitedBrazilian soccer icon Neymar was seen getting around Universal Orlando Resort on a mobility scooter after Brazil's World Cup elimination.The ex-Barcelona star visited the theme park on Thursday, just days after Brazil crashed out of the World Cup following a loss to Norway.Neymar stands as Brazil's record goal scorer with 80 strikes, his latest coming from the penalty spot in their 2-1 loss to Norway. In the footage, he's dressed in grey shorts and a black and white t-shirt, completing the look with a hat and sunglasses.• Former Spain Prime Minister sparks racism storm before World Cup semifinal with France• David Beckham behavior during England national anthem next to wife Victoria turns headsThis sighting follows Neymar's announcement that he's stepping away from international soccer after Brazil's World Cup exit. A witness told Sell Us Your Story: "No one really cottoned on to the fact it was him at first, and then he got mobbed.Advertisement"I've no idea why he was on the scooter - but it was scorching hot.Neymar was seen at the Orlando park on Thursday"We first realized he was there as we were at a restaurant in a different part of the park, and then we overheard some security guard say it was Neymar, so we headed to the next part of the park.""We came through, and they thought we were security, so we got to stay relatively close."Neymar reacts after losing the round of 16 football match against Norway -Credit:AFP via Getty ImagesMeanwhile, England clinched a 2-1 victory over Norway on Saturday to advance to their fourth World Cup semi-final.This marks the seventh occasion England have reached the semi-finals of a major competition, excluding the 1968 European Championship when just four nations qualified for the finals. Argentina battled past a determined 10-man Switzerland side, securing a 3-1 extra-time win in Kansas City to book their place in a semi-final showdown against England.
author: Kelly Williams
